title: Promotions lift sales 20.5%
detail: Measured across 2,024 promoted rows (13.9% of days).
action: Concentrate promo budget on the highest-uplift product families and peak weekdays.

title: Saturday runs 55% above Tuesday
action: Move shift hours from Tuesday to Saturday.

title: May is the seasonal peak
action: Lock in supplier capacity and seasonal hiring ~6 weeks before May.

title: Demand is flat
detail: Next 30 days track within +1.4% of the last 30 days.
action: Hold current inventory and staffing plans.

title: Bottom 1 products contribute 11.4% of sales
detail: The long tail ties up shelf space and working capital.
action: Review the tail for delisting or reduced facings at low-volume stores.

title: 1 anomalous days in the last 90 days
action: Confirm these are real events (closures, stockouts) before trusting the forecast there.

title: Top forecast drivers
detail: The model leans hardest on sales_roll28_mean, sales_lag_7, sales_lag_14.
action: Keep these inputs clean and available at forecast time; they carry most of the signal.
